products.title: Enebe Mx Turbo Red 2027 - Enebe
products.description:
ENEBE MX TURBO RED 2027 - The Enebe MX Turbo Red 2027 is a racket for those who want to play fast, place the ball with precision and feel confident even on the most complicated shots. Its wide sweet spot, HR3 Black EVA core and Impact Marks roughness offer a combination of control, agility and firmness to enjoy dynamic play. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ENEBE MX TURBO RED 2027 has something that is very appreciated in padel: it allows you to focus on the point without worrying about whether you are going to reach each ball well placed.

It is a teardrop format racket with which you achieve both power and control.

PLAYER TYPE

We find it especially suitable for medium-high and advanced level players who have an active game and like to anticipate their rival.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This Red version maintains that agile character of the MX Turbo family, with a sporty aesthetic that gives it a touch of personality. An Enebe for those who enjoy playing with speed, but without losing their minds trying to finish all the points the first time.

The ENEBE MX TURBO RED 2027 is committed to an aerodynamic structure and a very large sweet spot, two details that help to gain reaction speed and offer greater margin when we hit off-center.

Made with 12K carbon fiber, a firm and most powerful carbon. Its HR3 Black EVA core combines quick recovery with a firm feel, allowing you to control the ball output without losing response when accelerating. The carbon frame reinforces the whole and provides stability against impacts, while the Impact Marks technology incorporates a three-dimensional roughness that favors the grip of the ball in different directions.

products.title: Paletero Siux Edge Blanco 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX EDGE WHITE PADEL BAG 2026 - This is the new Siux padel bag with the best quality-price ratio. It has everything for an experienced player who needs a lot of space. The SIUX EDGE WHITE 2026 PADEL BAG is a model recommended for advanced players who are looking for something practical, manageable and well organized. It is large but without being over the top, it has a very compact size and has absolutely all the pockets that a high-end padel bag should have,

Its size is ideal for everyday use with respect to padel, as it offers enough space for two rackets, clothing and accessories, but with a comfortable format that does not get in the way or weigh excessively.

The main compartment allows you to organize your equipment easily, while the independent space for sneakers prevents mixing shoes with clean clothes. The exterior pockets are designed for what always ends up lost: keys, cell phone, grips or small accessories that you need to have on hand.

products.title: Black Crown Hurricane Pro 4.0 - Black Crown
products.description:
BLACK CROWN HURRICANE PRO 4.0 - The new Hurricane arrives, one of the most desired Black Crown padel rackets each season without a doubt. Version 4.0 signed by Marta Marrero. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The BLACK CROWN HURRICANE PRO 4.0 arrives quite renewed and we find it to be a particularly interesting racket for the advanced player who wants to have a lot of control, but needs the racket to respond when it comes to accelerating. Although it has a round format, this is not a purely defensive racket: it has character, a firm touch and enough power to finish points from the net.

PLAYER TYPE

We recommend this model for experienced high-level players who want a professional racket to perform at their best.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

On the planes we find 12K Power Carbon, which gives it that firm and precise hit that we expect from a high-level racket. When we hit hard, it responds very well and conveys a lot of confidence, something we especially like in volleys, layups and shots.

Inside it incorporates SC Black EVA with a density of 15, a rubber that goes very well with the 12K carbon. The result is a balanced touch, with good ball output when we play at a slower speed and a more forceful response when we press the shot.

The Hybrid Spin finish helps work spin on vipers, layups and slice shots.

It also incorporates a longer handle, a particularly interesting detail for players who use the two-handed backhand.

products.title: Dunlop Fx Team 2026 - Dunlop
products.description:
DUNLOP FX TEAM 2026 - Perfect for intermediate or even advanced players. An offensive racket, since the FX series stands out for it.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The DUNLOP FX TEAM 2026 is a padel racket designed to offer us a perfect balance between power, control and precision. It is the most versatile model in the FX series. With a beautiful design in gray and blue, in a diamond format that will offer us high balance.

PLAYER TYPE

Ideal for players looking for versatile and constant performance on each point. Its diamond format is perfect for intermediate or advanced backhand players.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Its structure incorporates Force Bridge technology in the bridge, which provides greater stability when hitting, allowing more powerful hits.

At the core, it has Pro EVA rubber, a foam that offers a firm but reactive touch. On the other hand, thanks to SpinBoost, the grip on the ball is increased, facilitating the generation of spin to dominate with topspin or sliced ​​shots.

One of the most effective technologies of this racket is the Power Holes, based on the strategic distribution of the holes, it expands the sweet spot and provides greater precision in hitting.

products.description:
SIUX NEO BALL CAN - Balls designed for players looking for a quick game but without losing control. They offer a lively bounce, consistent response and firm feel from the first hit, maintaining their optimal behavior for longer thanks to their high-resistance felt.

 We present the SIUX NEO BALL CAN, padel balls designed to revolutionize your game with their perfect combination of speed and control. They are balls with a live bounce and immediate response. Prepared to demand the best sensations on the track from the first point.
